en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 142 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Ali from Uthman bin Ahmad Sammak from Ibrahim bin Abdullah Hashmi from Hasan bin Fadhl Busrai from Saad Ibn Abdul Hamid Ansari from Abdullah bin Ziyad Yamami from Akrama bin Ammar from Ishaq bin Abdullah bin Abi Talha from Anas bin Malik that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: “We, the children of Abdul Muttalib are the chiefs of Paradise dwellers; that is I, Ali, Hamza (chief of the martyrs), Ja’far with two wings, Hasan, Husain, and the Mahdi.”
